paragraphs.text: Critical vulnerabilities in PTC Windchill and FlexPLM PLM software and Zoom Workplace for Windows have been patched, requiring control owners to verify asset coverage and remediation status across vulnerability and access management programs. The unauthenticated privilege escalation in a widely deployed collaboration tool and the remote code execution flaw in product lifecycle management platforms both demand confirmation of affected inventories and privileged access boundaries.

An international law enforcement operation dismantled Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC infrastructure, while Apify rotated secrets after a breach, Microsoft acknowledged Windows updates degrading SQL Server, and N-able investigated exploits against patched N-central servers. These developments test incident response evidence retention, third-party OAuth assurance, change validation for core databases, and configuration-specific vulnerability remediation.
